claim_summaries.claim: For a rational orthogonal block-diagonal F, all ordinary column leverage scores of V=[I,F^T] are 1/2, while the hard-pair row maxima r_i can be exponential in the input bit length.
claim_summaries.scope: Exact family F=direct-sum 2x2 rotations; full derivation in INITIAL.txt.

claim_summaries.claim: Ordinary determinant leverage scores and rejection from the unfiltered determinant DPP do not acquire the required balance ratios with polynomial cost on the weak-block family.
claim_summaries.scope: Rules out these specific acquisition routes; no general computational lower bound.

claim_summaries.claim: A convex program over the hard-hole generating function needs its value/gradient or a numerical coefficient estimator; the supplied stable/support representations alone do not provide one.
claim_summaries.scope: Interface audit; a new polynomial-time no-count evaluation method is not ruled out.
